traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Cynomoriaceae: leaves alternate; plants monoecious or polygamous; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers in spikes or in heads; perianth tepals; fruit nut; stamens 1; carpels 2.
